target_identity: AI-assisted software developer, automation builder, technical business analyst, and workflow systems developer
positioning_statement: Experienced business analyst and systems builder with strong background in SQL, BI, CRM workflows, process automation, and AI-assisted software development using GitHub Copilot, Ollama, local agents, Python, C#, JavaScript, FastAPI, Docker, and workflow-based development.

relevant_projects.name: JobBlade / JobFlow
relevant_projects.description: Local job evaluation workflow using Brave extension, Docker backend, Ollama, structured candidate profiles, vacancy parsing, and evidence-based AI recommendations.

relevant_projects.name: Valkyrie EFB
relevant_projects.description: Electronic flight bag concept with modules for METAR, TAF, NOTAMs, VAC charts, memory items, documents, SQLite/IndexedDB storage, and offline-first mobile/PWA workflows.

relevant_projects.name: Saga Journal
relevant_projects.description: SaaS/mobile concept for structured journaling, memory recaps, calendar views, offline notes, sentiment analysis, and AI-assisted summaries.

relevant_projects.name: Joplin Automation Scripts
relevant_projects.description: Python-based automation connected to Joplin Web Clipper for note processing, tag-triggered actions, TTS generation, GPT expansion, and structured knowledge workflows.

relevant_projects.name: YNAB / Financial Dashboard Tools
relevant_projects.description: Financial analysis and dashboard concepts using SQL data, forecasting, hardship thresholds, Power BI/Dash-style visualizations, and transaction categorization.

acceptable_roles: Junior/Mid AI Engineer if practical and tool-focused
Prompt Engineer if linked to software workflows
Technical Project Manager for AI implementation
avoid_roles: Deep Learning Engineer requiring advanced math
MLOps Engineer requiring Kubernetes-heavy production experience
hard_rejection_rules: Reject if role requires Danish fluency.
Reject Denmark jobs if existing Danish residency or work permit is explicitly required.
Reject Denmark jobs if relocation support is explicitly not offered.
Reject roles requiring PhD-level machine learning, deep learning research, or heavy statistical modeling as core requirements.
Reject roles where Kubernetes, Terraform, cloud infrastructure, SRE, or DevOps are the main responsibility.
Reject roles that require 5+ years of production ML engineering if the work is not primarily workflow, automation, analytics, or applied AI tooling.
Reject roles with salary below USD 50,000/year unless remote Panama-based and strategically useful.

decision_style.evaluate_for: practical AI/software automation fit, not academic AI research
decision_style.default_goal: find roles where business analysis, software building, automation, and local AI workflow experience create an advantage
